def extract_songs_from_text(text):
    if not text:
        return []
    # Capture lines like "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    songs = []
    # Normalize newlines
    t = text.replace('\r\n','\n').replace('\r','\n')
    for line in t.split('\n'):
        line_stripped = line.strip()
        # Often formatted as "- <title> by <artists>"
        m = re.match(r'^[-•]\s*(.+?)\s+by\s+(.+?)\s*$', line_stripped, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists = m.group(2).strip()
            # Remove trailing punctuation
            artists = re.sub(r'[\.;:!\?]+$','',artists).strip()
            songs.append((title, artists))
    return songs

for tid in candidate_thread_ids:

            for title, artists in songs:

import re
from collections import defaultdict

song_specs = [
    {'title': 'Journey Through the Unknown', 'artists_raw': 'Hazel Winter, Ava Morgan', 'source_thread_id': 47821, 'source_email_id': 20867},
    {'title': 'A Love Written in the Stars', 'artists_raw': 'Ava Morgan', 'source_thread_id': 47821, 'source_email_id': 20867},
    {'title': 'Fragile Bonds', 'artists_raw': 'Jasper Skye', 'source_thread_id': 47821, 'source_email_id': 20867},
]


def norm(s):
    s = (s or '').lower().strip()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()
    return s


def parse_artists(artists_raw):
    # split on commas
    parts = [a.strip() for a in (artists_raw or '').split(',')]
    parts = [re.sub(r"[\.;:!\?]+$", "", a).strip() for a in parts if a.strip()]
    return parts


def search_all_songs(query, page_limit=20):
    page_index = 0
    results = []
    while True:
        resp = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
        # resp is list per schema
        if not resp:
            break
        results.extend(resp)
        print('  page', page_index, 'got', len(resp), 'total', len(results))
        if len(resp) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return results


chosen = []

print('EXTRACTED SONG SPECS')
for i, sp in enumerate(song_specs, 1):
    print(i, sp['title'], '| artists_raw:', sp['artists_raw'])

print('\nSEARCH + MATCHING')
for sp in song_specs:
    title = sp['title']
    artists = parse_artists(sp['artists_raw'])

    # Search using title only first
    query = title
    print('\n-- Searching for:', query, '| parsed artists:', artists)
    all_results = search_all_songs(query)

    # Filter by title exact-ish match
    nt = norm(title)
    title_matches = []
    for r in all_results:
        if norm(r.get('title')) == nt:
            title_matches.append(r)

    print('Total results:', len(all_results), 'Title exact matches:', len(title_matches))

    # Further filter by artist names if possible
    if artists:
        artist_norms = [norm(a) for a in artists]
        def r_has_artist(r):
            r_artists = [norm(a.get('name')) for a in r.get('artists', [])]
            # accept if any artist name matches
            return any(ra in artist_norms for ra in r_artists)
        artist_matches = [r for r in title_matches if r_has_artist(r)]
        print('Artist-filtered matches:', len(artist_matches))
    else:
        artist_matches = title_matches

    # Choose single if unique
    chosen_song = None
    candidate_list = artist_matches

    if len(candidate_list) == 1:
        chosen_song = candidate_list[0]
    else:
        # If 0 or multiple, try broader search using title + first artist (or all)
        query2 = title + ' ' + ' '.join(artists) if artists else title
        print('Ambiguous/none after exact+artist filter; trying query2:', query2)
        all_results2 = search_all_songs(query2)
        title_matches2 = [r for r in all_results2 if norm(r.get('title')) == nt]
        print('Query2 total:', len(all_results2), 'Title exact matches2:', len(title_matches2))
        if artists:
            artist_norms = [norm(a) for a in artists]
            def r_has_artist(r):
                r_artists = [norm(a.get('name')) for a in r.get('artists', [])]
                return any(ra in artist_norms for ra in r_artists)
            candidate_list2 = [r for r in title_matches2 if r_has_artist(r)]
            print('Query2 artist-filtered matches2:', len(candidate_list2))
        else:
            candidate_list2 = title_matches2

        if len(candidate_list2) == 1:
            chosen_song = candidate_list2[0]
        else:
            # If still not unique, keep none (no guessing)
            chosen_song = None
            candidate_list = candidate_list2

    # Print verification row
    if chosen_song:
        chosen.append({'title': title, 'artists_raw': sp['artists_raw'], 'song_id': chosen_song['song_id'], 'matched_title': chosen_song['title'], 'matched_artists': ', '.join([a['name'] for a in chosen_song.get('artists',[])])})
        print('CHOSEN song_id', chosen_song['song_id'], '| matched_title:', chosen_song['title'], '| matched_artists:', [a['name'] for a in chosen_song.get('artists',[])])
    else:
        # show up to 3 candidates if any
        print('COULD NOT UNIQUELY RESOLVE for:', title)
        print('Candidate count:', len(candidate_list))
        for r in candidate_list[:3]:
            print('  candidate song_id', r.get('song_id'), 'title', r.get('title'), 'artists', [a.get('name') for a in r.get('artists',[])])

print('\nCHOSEN SONGS:')
for c in chosen:
    print(c)

print('chosen_count', len(chosen))
